result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 5, Article 4) covering abandoned personal property and abatement of abandoned properties and vacant structures, retrieved from a page URL that suggests the anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing division (§ 98.1103) but with no such text in this part.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code §§ 54.0212 to 54.0313 on abandoned personal property, vacant structures and public nuisance abatement. None of it concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. The algorithmic rent-setting text (§ 98.1103) named in the source URL does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted.
